source.notes: ICSE Class IX school second terminal examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'SECOND TERMINAL EXAMINATION (2024-25)', 'Std: IX', 'Subject: Mathematics', 'Duration: 3 hours', 'Maximum Marks: 80' (the inner title also prints 'Time allowed: Three Hours' plus 15 minutes reading time); every page footer prints 'IC/STD IX/2425' (recorded as paperCode) and 'Page n of 6'. examYear 2025 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). Section A (40 marks, compulsory): Question 1 (fifteen MCQs) prints only a group total [15] and is kept as one entry; Questions 2-3 print marks per part. Section B: attempt any four of Questions 4-10, so the pack's marks total exceeds 80. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images (notation rebuilt from the images). Handwritten ticks and a handwritten '13' on the Question 9 (i) figure are ignored. Figures are not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.sectionTitle: Section A (40 marks) Attempt all questions from this Section
questions.text:
(i) What is the value of x² + y², if x + y = 8 and xy = 5? (a) 59 (b) 54 (c) 50 (d) 58
(ii) Factorization of x² − 4x − 12 is (a) (x+6)(x−2) (b) (x−6)(x+2) (c) (x−6)(x−2) (d) (x+6)(x+2)
(iii) Which of the following is the correct way to rationalize the denominator of 15/(√63 + √20)? (a) 15/(√63 + √20) × (3√7 − 2√5)/(3√7 − 2√5) (b) (15 + (3√7 − 4√5))/((√63 + √20)(3√7 − 2√5)) (c) 15/(√63 + √20) × (3√7 − 4√5)/(3√7 − 4√5) (d) (15 + (3√7 − 2√5))/((√63 + √20)(3√7 − 2√5))
(iv) The value of sin58°/cos32° + cos58°/sin32° is (a) 1 (b) 0 (c) 2 (d) 1/2
(v) If sin θ = a/b then the value of cot θ will be (a) √(b² − a²)/b (b) a/√(b² − a²) (c) √(b² − a²)/a (d) b/√(b² − a²)
(vi) What is the value of m if 6^(2m−3)/6^(−9) = 6^20 (a) 5 (b) 20 (c) 10 (d) 7
(vii) If D and E are the midpoints of sides AB and AC of triangle ABC, what is DE in relation to BC? (a) DE = BC (b) DE is perpendicular to BC (c) DE = 1/2 BC (d) DE is double of BC
(viii) What is the distance of the point (5, −12) from the origin? (a) 11 units (b) 13 units (c) 15 units (d) 16 units
(ix) If α is an acute angle, and √3 cot 2α = 1, then the value of α is (a) 60° (b) 30° (c) 90° (d) 0°
(x) A point P (a, b) is such that a < 0, b > 0. In which quadrant does the point P lie? (a) First quadrant (b) Second quadrant (c) Third quadrant (d) Fourth quadrant
(xi) If ABC and DBC are two isosceles triangles on the same base BC. Then: (a) ∠ABD =∠ACD (b) ∠ABD >∠ACD (c) ∠ABD <∠ACD (d) ∠BAC =∠BDC
(xii) A boy cycles 120 m towards north and 160 m towards west. How far is he from the starting point? (a) 250 m (b) 200 m (c) 240 m (d) 300 m
(xiii) Statement I: The median of an ungrouped data can be calculated by arranging the data in ascending order. Statement II: The median of an ungrouped data can be calculated by arranging the data in descending order. Which is the correct option? (a) Statement I is correct (b) Statement II is correct (c) Both I and II are correct (d) Both I and II are incorrect
(xiv) In two triangles, ABC and PQR, ∠A = 30°, ∠B = 70°, ∠P = 70°, ∠Q = 80° and AB = RP, then (a) ΔABC ≅ΔPQR (b) ΔABC ≅ΔQRP (c) ΔABC ≅ΔRPQ (d) ΔABC ≅ΔRQP
(xv) Assertion (A): A chord of a circle, which is twice as long as its radius, is a diameter of the circle. Reason (R): Any chord, whose length is twice as long as the radius of the circle, passes through the centre of the circle. (a) A is true, R is false (b) A is false, R is true (c) both A and R are true (d) both A and R are false
